profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Technical leader with extensive experience in software development and team management. Bridges
hardware and software disciplines and draws on diverse industry knowledge to see problems from every
angle, then translates that insight into practical, sustainable solutions that make it to production.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Jira · Git · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Root Cause · Log Management

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
+ Refactor software build system, CI, and CD infrastructure to produce traceable and reproducible in bitbucket pipelines.
+ Develop IP Media Trust Boundary (SMPTE-2022 NAT and Firewall) application and features to support analysis and transport.
+ Software feature developments: PDV measurement, Flow Detection, PID Detection, Logging Service.
+ Design REST API in OpenAPI 3.0 standard and develop tools to integrate API into C++ code base.
+ Benchmark and integrate C++ web framework to provide API from applications.
+ Design and develop customer requested feature. Work with customer on integration and issues.
+ Designed, implemented, deploy and integrated testing framework written ground up on Python used by sw engineers, hw engineers, testers, and support.

ARM Cortex-A9, Linux RTOS, C++11/17, Python, REST, Swagger/OpenAPI 3.0, YAML, JSON, Docker

positions.title: Staff Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
+ Resolve critical issues in Time Synchronization for multi-chassis software leading to customer retention. 
+ Designed, implemented, and integrated NMEA 0183 standard for GPS Time Synchronization.
+ Implemented RADClock solution to provide fast and accurate time synchronization over NTP protocol.
+ Proposed alternate solutions to complex problems; providing an external perspective out of the status quo. 
+ Developed internal procedures for documentation, code review, and coding standards.
+ Investigate, root cause, and resolve customer escalations.

X86, Yacto Linux, C++98, Python, QEMU, LXC, NTP, PTP, GPS, Perforce, Jira, Confluence, BDD
positions.insights: Skills: Internet Protocol Suite (TCP/IP) · Agile Development · Jira · Virtual Machines · Git · Root Cause · Network Time Protocol (NTP) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Virtualization · Kernel-based Virtual Machine (KVM) · Real-Time Transport Protocol (RTP) · Algorithms · Lxc

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description:
+ Lead and manage a team of 4 software engineers.  
+ Transition software development processes from waterfall to agile methodology.  
+ Provide software development plans and risk mitigation strategies to upper management.  
+ Create software architecture and specification documentation for firmware development.  
+ Established standard development procedures and best practices. Train software team in agile methodology. 
+ Liaison between cross functional team to provide software support, development, integration, and testing. 
+ Develop interface software for integration between ARM Cortex-A8 MCU and Xilinx Artix-7 FPGA.

ARM Cortex-A8, TI MSP, Freescale HSC12, Xilinx Artix-7, Sciopta RTOS, C, C++14, I2C, SPI, UART, 
Device Drivers, IAR Embedded Workbench/IAR Compiler, PID Controller, Agile, Scrum
positions.insights: Skills: Signal Processing · Internet Protocol Suite (TCP/IP) · Agile Development · Jira · Git · Root Cause · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · I2C · Algorithms

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
+ Software development for Navy Railgun Radar System and Hardware In The Loop (HWIL) simulation. 
+ Integrate legacy software and new development for a uniform software development base. 
+ User interface planning and development for Radar and Simulator. 

XES Systems, Embedded Linux RTOS, C, C++, C#, ZeroMQ, GitLab, Jenkins
positions.insights: Skills: Signal Processing · Git · Root Cause · I2C · Algorithms

positions.title: Principal Channel Systems Engineer
positions.description:
+ Lead channel firmware developer for the first 600GB 10000RPM VelociRaptor HDD release. 
+ Work with cross functional teams for strategic execution to reduce time to market. 
+ Develop and own manufacturing commands to drive commonality between consumer and enterprise. 
+ Implement Hardware Abstraction Layer for Read Channel to support multiple vendors. 
+ Bring up and maintain new Channel SoC implementations. 
+ Provide failure analysis and firmware debugging to product and development teams. 
+ Develop and implement firmware algorithms for channel optimization.

Marvell and LSI SoCs, C/C++, Tcl/Tk, Subversion, JTAG/ICE Debuggers, Automation, Algorithms
positions.insights: Skills: Signal Processing · Root Cause · I2C · Algorithms
